PRINTABLE BODY PARTS CARDS

Body Parts & Five Senses Flashcards: print all twenty-four cards

Twenty-four cards, two to a printed page — every body part and every sense word, from head to feel.

Made for age 3 and up — one clear picture per card, kept in card order. The cards print in card order — cut them out or use them as they are. When you are ready, choose Print Cards.

Back to class ↗

Printing happens in your browser — nothing is uploaded and nothing is installed. No PDF is involved.
